cities.name: Singapore
cities.description: Ambitious and futuristic urbanization began in earnest with the development of industrial Jurong Town in 1961 and the city-state has not looked back since.

cities.name: Nusantara
cities.description: Initiated with the conceptualization, masterplan, and urban design competition in 2019, Nusantara began to be effectively built and expanded in 2022 post-COVID, finished the 1st phase of the development in 2024, and is currently under the 2nd stage until 2029, the end of the presidency of Prabowo Subianto. Prabowo stated that he and the entire national government will be officially relocated to Nusantara at the beginning of 2029.

cities.name: Putrajaya
cities.description: Construction began in 1995 for the new administrative center off Kuala Lumpur, planned as a garden city with new Islamic architecture sited next to Cyberjaya. The year 2025 marked the 30 years of the Putrajaya development while it is still expanding to improve the socio-economic infrastructures.
